subject: *: add ctx parameter to infoschema TableByID (#55329)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent in scope (infoschema + DDL): the `InfoSchema.TableByID` signature change is mechanically propagated; v1 `infoSchema.TableByID` ignores ctx, and v2 passes ctx only into `loadTableInfo` for tracing. DDL/infoschema call sites in this commit pass non-nil contexts (mostly `context.Background()` or `d.ctx`/`e.ctx`), and no metadata/state-machine or add-index behavior changes with Blocker/High risk were found.
